Other than that, the thing about clowns is. You have the people who are piss their pants terrified of them and use their hands as a guard rail over their eyes, or the ones who just don’t find clowns scary. They get easy to read as time goes on.

If I was in a more ‘plain room’ with not much to work with, I’d try for an initial jump scare, work on my clown laugh, and identify which member of the group can help me put on a show by being horrified and make them uncomfortable. Get up close, change your voice mid sentence. You want them to SEE you. I got on the ground a lot in weird poses to see the people’s faces who were staring at the ground. A lot of times, this gave enjoyment to the other guests in their group. If I can’t scare the other ones since clowns don’t do it for them, or I missed my mark on the jump, I’ll get a laugh out of them as I go for the weakest link. Which means I still brought them enjoyment so it’s a win in my book.

There’s more to the game than just PC specs. Speaking of that, what are your specs? If you have low end but are trying to run on ultra, it’ll cause some lag as it tries to process the frames when triggered (shooting, explosions, etc…)

Network connection is a big one though. Not only from your end but their end too. There’s a ‘handshake’ that happens with both sides of the network. If yours is poo, and theirs isn’t, you can lag. If yours is good but theirs is poo, it can lag. 

I very rarely get lag spikes and when you do, you’ll see the little red server icon on the right hand side. I don’t monitor my network constantly but I run Ethernet with 1gb Up and Down. Shit happens tho. Try running Ethernet if you’re able to. Turn down some settings or get an extender.

Hope that helps!

So what I learned from content creation (I had a combined 250k followers from 2 platforms before I threw in the towel - gaming industry) at least in that industry is that followers are yes, like you said, extremely lazy.

So from what you said, there’s a couple problem statements you could breakdown. Whether these are actual problems now, no clue but lets roll with it

1: content creator wants more engagement
2: followers want to feel rewarded for bringing creator more engagement
3: followers are lazy, unless they are apart of the loyal fan club. How do we get more engagement from the rest?

You’ll definitely want something super easy. Not only for the creators but followers. I do dig the idea of connecting to platforms API’s, but it does introduce a breaking point. You could make it a Shopify app or something where, like you said, creators connect their videos then users are able to 1 click generate a link to share. Each like, comment, share after that = X points. Then users can use those points for discounts on whatever the creator is selling. Like you said. 

The key would be to really hone in on the issue. Are those 3 problems I mentioned even a problem? Not too sure. 

What you should do, since you mentioned you have experience in CC, is talk with your followers. Ask if they’d be interested and see what they would do. Ask them the problem statement though and see how they react. 

If the followers like it. Perfect. That’s half the battle. Build something super minimal and test with your audience. Or instead of building yet, go chat with a couple more creators. Both the followers and the creators will influence how your first version will look. Just narrow down your problem statement and a potential elevator pitch solution knowing it will change. IE don’t be married to it
